title: 10.1.2 | Bugfix Patch
body:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/e140f8b71622b069f7ed7f4a0146c1b835661b2d.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][p][b]The Judgment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the Divine Light curve window while Zealous to 0.8s [i](was 0.6s)[/i][/p][list][*][p][i]Dev note: In hotfix 1 we increased the Zealous Curve window to 0.6s. However, that duration was shorter based on how long Divine Light was controlled - similar to how it was on the PTB. Because it can get pretty short, we felt it was safe to further increase it to 0.8s. We will continue monitoring this.
[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a 0.3s Divine Light curve window when non-Zealous[/p][list][*][p][i]Dev note: The curving has been a hugely appreciated mechanic to the Zealous state, giving opportunities to outplay Survivors from close range. To give The Judgment an edge when outside of the Zealous state, we're adding a shorter curve window to Divine Light. Zealous is still worth getting due to the longer curve window but being non-Zealous will provide more outplay potential.
[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Survivors being Liberated from Exile respawn at least 32m away from The Judgment and get a 1s immunity to Divine Light[/p][list][*][p][i]Dev note: After spending some time in Exile, returning to the Entity's Realm can be disorienting. Sometimes Survivors come back and The Judgment is right there, re-initiating a chase with them, to no fault of their (The Judgment's) own. To reduce the amount of times a Survivor that is freshly out of Exile gets chased again, we'll be respawning them away from the Killer. The 1s immunity is there to make sure a stray Divine Light doesn't accidentally hit - giving them a proper chance at a reset.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Game Mode: 2v8[/b][/h2][h3][b]NEW KILLER[/b][/h3][p][b]The Xenomorph - Innate Skills:[/b][/p][list][*][p]When a turret takes The Xenomorph out of Crawler Mode it is automatically destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]The cooldown of Crawler Mode is 25% faster while outside of tunnels[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors hit by a Tail Strike are Mangled for 70 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]After exiting a tunnel, gain 5% Haste for 3 seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW ITEM: INVOKING SALT[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Survivors will obtain [b]Invoking Salt[/b] from Chests. It can be used [b]once,[/b] consumed the moment it is placed. Placement takes [b]3 seconds[/b][/p][/*][*][p]When it is placed, up to 4 Survivors can perform a [b]40 second[/b] interaction that allows them to use their [b]Unlockable Skill[/b] without being Hooked and gain a [b]5% Haste[/b] boost for 5 minutes, which reduces by [b]1%[/b] after each minute passes. Performing the Ritual subsequent times will refresh the Haste bonus and duration[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]KILLER UPDATE[/b][/h3][p][b]The Ghostface[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Night Shroud charge rate from [b]15%[/b] to [b]20%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Increased Stalking charge rate from [b]10%[/b] to [b]15%[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Executioner[/b][/p][list][*][p] Increased Punishment Of The Damned width by [b]2 meters[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]SURVIVOR CLASS UPDATE[/b][/h3][p][b]Guide Class[/b][/p][list][*][p]Successfully completing a Skill Check while the Killer is within [b]24 meters[/b] will reveal their Aura for [b]5 seconds[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Survivor Starting Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each Survivor Class is now granted a Default Item of [b]Uncommon [/b]rarity:[/p][list][*][p][b]Medic [/b]- First Aid Kit[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scout [/b]- Dull Key[/p][/*][*][p][b]Escapist [/b]- Artisan's Fog Vial[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guide[/b] - Toolbox[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW MAP[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Nostromo Wreckage is now available in 2v8[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]IMPROVED UNCAGE ANGLES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Uncaging is now supported from the sides, similar to hooks[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]INCREASED CHESTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Number of Chest spawns has been increased from 20 to 27[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Tome's theme can be played in the Offline Lobby by holding Left Click.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Animatronic's default footsteps sounded muffled, and Glitchtrap’s footsteps sounded too metallic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Xenomorph’s Tail Strike was too loud.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Xenomorph is unable to hear the turret's beeping warning sound upon approaching it in both Custom and 2v8 Trials.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Characters[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Pig could stay in a crouched state while carrying a Survivor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Pig's un-crouch animation was not playing properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Knight's Guards would get stuck in Pallets dropped during the Hunt.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Judgment's Divine Light would reveal Survivors hidden in lockers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Judgment trying to send a Survivor to Exile right before Heresy expired would cause the Survivor to become permanently invisible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Judgment was able to Exile escaped Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors on Nostromo Wreckage could rarely be sent to the secret room when rescued from Exile against The Judgment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a Heretic Survivor could get Killer Instinct while in the process of returning from Exile against The Judgment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a hooked Survivor could get Heresy against The Judgment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the bot would be stuck in Exile until the end of the End Game Collapse when an Exiled Survivor disconnected while getting rescued against The Judgment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors in Exile did not affect the End Game Collapse timer against The Judgment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Judgment's proximity Killer Instinct would sometimes activate after hitting a Survivor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where blinded Survivors were unable to see The Judgment's Shrine aura.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the outfit True Blight displayed placeholder VFX on the back of the outfit in the Customization tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Cybil Bennett's badge and cosmetic's description were shown as Lisa Garland.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Environment/Maps[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Dead Dawg Saloon where a crawling Survivor could not get to the top of the stairs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Badham Preschool where a bush was blocking players from navigating properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Raccoon City Police Station where a collision was blocking projectiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Torment Creek where players could hide behind a Killer item in the main building.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Garden of Joy where a missing collision on the rooftop fence allowed Survivors to become immune to the Killer's basic attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Torment Creek where a wall collision on the main building allowed projectiles to pass through it.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the perk "Vigil" would still affect other status effects beyond Exhausted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where perk "Nowhere to Hide" had an inconsistent description and in-game aura reveal range.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The First's Gameplay Showcase descriptions contained multiple errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Dead By Daylight logo's visibility on the play button.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where SFX were missing with the matchmaking button interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when loading into a Custom game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where checkmarks while matchmaking were missing for the local player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where estimated queue time was missing when matchmaking.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ban state not resetting the matchmaking button when reaching 0.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]2v8[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a window in the chapel could only be vaulted from one side on Father Campbell's Chapel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a collision issue preventing navigation on Sanctum of Wrath.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a rock was blocking navigation on Family Residence.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors were unable to vault a Endurance status effect after performing an Uncage action.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors could climb on top of a mop bucket on Raccoon City Police Station.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Nurse could Blink into a hill on Autohaven Wreckers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Dark Lord could get stuck on the meat hooks in Mother's Dwelling.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Anti-Camp bar was missing while spectating.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the camera would sometimes become stuck after being sacrificed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors who changed classes from Torchbearer would see a Flashlight in their hands in the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a crate's aura was missing when a Survivor was infected by The Mastermind or The Nemesis when they were both Killers in the Trial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Antidote item in the 2v8 game mode would have an unknown rarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Nostromo
